reported.title: Blocking delay in siren burst
reported.description: The use of delay() in runSirenBurst() blocks the loop, preventing the heartbeat from being emitted and potentially causing the firmware to go silent for more than 700 ms.

reported.title: Siren pulse restart on door press
reported.description: The siren pulse can be restarted if the door switch is pressed again during the delay, which violates the requirement to ignore additional presses while the siren is running.

judge_input.spec:
- Kiln door switch on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); siren driver on D8.
- A settled door-open press as short as 40 ms starts a 2000 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 150 ms.
- While a siren pulse is already running, additional presses are ignored (do not restart the pulse).
- Print the exact line `hb` every 250 ms at all times, including during the siren pulse.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no pin change) for more than 700 ms.
- Idle door contact reads HIGH.
